The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds.

The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

Ever seen the prices of a new engine casing or the cost of removing debris from your engine? source_description_html: Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filtering; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds. The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

source_description_html: Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filters; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds. The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

source_description_html: Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filtering; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds. The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must have accessory.

Carbon Fibre Lever Guard for BMW M1000RR '21- (LG0043C)

Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filtering; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds.

The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race-oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must-have accessory.

This Carbon Fibre Lever Guard kit has been specifically designed for the BMW M1000RR '21- models.

description: R&G Lever Guards are stylish, easy to install, and, much like all R&G products, unbelievably strong, offering serious protection. You'll see R&G Lever Guards being…
source_description_html:
R&G Lever Guards are stylish, easy to install, and, much like all R&G products, unbelievably strong, offering serious protection. You'll see R&G Lever Guards being used worldwide by some of the world's best race teams. Our Range of Lever Guards includes Carbon Lever Guards, Moulded Lever Guards, and Brake Lever Guards. 

R&G Lever Guards including Brake Lever Guards, Moulded Lever Guards & Carbon Lever Guards are approved by BSB & MotoAmerica.

Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filtering; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds.

The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race-oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must-have accessory.

Originally conceived in Moto2 but now adopted by almost every motorcycle body worldwide (ACU, MSVR, FIM, AMA) and required for racing, the 'Lever Guard' was developed to help avoid the accidental engagement of the front brake lever during close wheel to wheel racing (either from accidental contact with another bike or even a rider) but can equally be applied to road riding, protecting your lever(s) from wing mirror strikes while filtering; again potentially causing front brake engagement. Easy to install (fitting just like an R&G Bar End Slider) installation takes only seconds.

The specially designed super lightweight, yet super strong carbon fibre arm covers the end of the brake lever, plus its unique kink at its base allows your hand to fall cleanly off the handlebar grips should you be involved in an accident or crash. Like so many race-oriented products, these once quirky race bespoke products have now worked their way from the track to the road; so whether you're a professional racer, a track day enthusiast or simply a road rider! An R&G Lever Guard is a must-have accessory.
